create_upside_down_augmenter: create an UpsideDownAugmenter instance with char granularity and augmentation probability
flip_text_upside_down: flip text upside down by reversing and mapping characters using flip_text method
augment_words_upside_down: augment selected words in text by flipping them upside down with word granularity
